rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for restoring a person to health or bringing an illness to an end.

example.english: This medicine can cure my stomachache quickly.
example.traditional: 呢隻藥好快就醫好咗我嘅胃痛。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 joek6 hou2 faai3 zau6 ji1 hou2 zo2 ngo5 ge3 wai6 tung3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for medical treatment intended to cure an illness.

example.english: This cure is quite effective for asthma.
example.traditional: 呢個治療對哮喘幾有效。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi6 liu4 deoi3 haau1 cyun2 gei2 jau5 haau6

rows.note: Use this when the cure specifically means a medicine or drug rather than a treatment in general.

example.english: This medicine is the cure the doctor prescribed for me.
example.traditional: 呢隻藥係醫生開畀我嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 joek6 hai6 ji1 sang1 hoi1 bei2 ngo5 ge3

rows.note: Use this for recovery to health after an illness, rather than for the treatment that causes it.

example.english: Their cure took only three months after surgery.
example.traditional: 佢做完手術，三個月就康復喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 jyun4 sau2 seot6 saam1 go3 jyut6 zau6 hong1 fuk6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for restoration to soundness, especially after an injury or physical damage, rather than ordinary recovery from illness.

example.english: It took six weeks for my ankle to cure after the sprain.
example.traditional: 隻腳扭親之後，用咗六個星期先復原。
example.jyutping: zek3 goek3 nau2 can1 zi1 hau6 jung6 zo2 luk6 go3 sing1 kei4 sin1 fuk6 jyun4

rows.note: Use this for getting rid of a personal defect, bad habit, or undesirable trait rather than an illness.

example.english: I finally managed to cure my bad habit of staying up late.
example.traditional: 我終於改掉咗夜瞓嘅壞習慣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 goi2 diu6 zo2 je6 fan3 ge3 waai6 zaap6 gwaan3

rows.note: Use this for preserving food, especially meat, by salting or processing it.

example.english: We cure pork with salt so it keeps longer.
example.traditional: 我哋用鹽醃豬肉，可以放耐啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 jim4 jim1 zyu1 juk6 ho2 ji5 fong3 noi6 di1
